title: Han2024 – SSVEP fatigue dataset with two frequency paradigms
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings from 24 healthy participants performing two SSVEP-based brain-computer interface tasks designed to study the effects of fatigue. Each task used 16 targets, one in a low-frequency band (8.0-15.5 Hz) and one in a high-frequency band (25.5-33.0 Hz), with JFPM visual flicker encoding. Recordings cover a training phase and a fatigue phase, which supports evaluating dynamic stopping strategies and cross-session robustness of SSVEP decoding.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a Synamps2 amplifier (Neuroscan) using 64 channels, Cz reference, and impedance below 10 kOhm. Participants shifted gaze among 16 targets in a 4x4 layout, with 2 s stimulation per trial. Each frequency condition had 6 training blocks and 24 fatigue blocks of 16 trials each.
